name: hex / orbital
summary: neutral interface with blue highlights and a colorful eight-color element palette
document: use neutral black, grey and white interface surfaces with blue highlights in varied values and saturations. use eight more colorful non-blue element colors for tracks, clips, collections and sections; clips have normal and accented shades. one-shot actions are circles or pills; toggles are rectangular.
prompt: use neutral black, grey and white interface surfaces with blue highlights in varied values and saturations. use eight more colorful non-blue element colors for tracks, clips, collections and sections; clips have normal and accented shades. one-shot actions are circles or pills; toggles are rectangular.
rules: all app text is lowercase
all app text uses Ioskeley Mono
flat surfaces, one-pixel dividers, no decorative cards
keep transport and track context visible
prototype states do not establish audio or device behavior
preserve Live density; minimal dead space, small gutters, compact controls and contiguous panels
structural dividers are darker than the panels; text is softened but readable
browser tags are individually outlined chips at existing compact row positions
concept beauty takes priority over unique clip hue identification; text remains readable
clip colors are user-defined; maximum 64 saved swatches
one-shot buttons use full circles or rounded pills
toggled controls and mutually exclusive view selectors use rectangular shapes
fields, sliders, panels and user-colored clips are not classified as buttons
audio and midi clip headers share a 14 px height and dark names
each galaxy theme uses a black/grey core, one primary and three secondary accents
starlight: primary #d8c37d; secondary #d1dbe6, #8aa8ca, #aaaabe; clips #aba99c, #c0b28a, #98a9b8, #b4bec8, #a79f8c, #8fa3ae, #c4bfa9, #929cab
cyan galaxy: primary #46c5dd; secondary #728fe1, #77d3d0, #a3b0dd; clips #5c9cb4, #6593bb, #69a9b0, #7187b3, #6aa6bd, #7ab0ba, #7899ad, #6393a5
black and grey surfaces use neutral greys without a noticeable color cast
tracks, collections and sections use eight shared, colorful non-blue element colors
clips inherit their track color, either normal or a related accented shade
midi note previews use dark bars on the full clip-color background
accented clip shades: #ce7967, #d79659, #c5ae5b, #95b56b, #6bb68b, #6bb3aa, #b780ad, #d37c94
group and section clips use a distinct darker tier of their element colors

tokens.spacing: 1 px control padding; 20 px browser/scene rows; 100 px session strips; 24 px return strips
tokens.geometry: 1900 × 1120 desktop; 418 px browser; 218 px device dock or 346 px clip editor; fine square dividers; momentary controls use half-height corner radii; toggles have square corners
tokens.clipPalette: theme-palette.json / clip-colors.json: 56 related shades + 8 utilities, unequal chroma by hue family
